responsibility: Implements serialization of GCC tree nodes to the LTO/tree-streaming format. It writes identifiers and string constants to shared tables, packs non-pointer fields for the many tree structure variants into bitstreams, emits pointer bodies for decl/type/expr/block/constructor/OpenMP nodes, and writes tree headers and special integer-constant records, providing the outbound half of tree streaming used when GCC stores IR for LTO and related consumers.
